lab.name: Ertürk Lab

address.mapsQuery: Building 43, Helmholtz Munich, Ingolstädter Landstraße 1, 85764 Neuherberg, Germany

lab.mission: Our major goal is to accelerate biomedical research by developing and combining enabling technologies. We combine biomedical research with artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and engineering to solve major bottlenecks in research — from whole-body imaging to molecular analysis at single-cell resolution.
lab.missionHeadline: Accelerating biomedical research with enabling technologies
missionParagraphs: Our major goal is to accelerate biomedical research by developing and combining enabling technologies. We combine biomedical research with artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and engineering.
From unbiased whole-body imaging to molecular analysis at single-cell resolution — we tackle major bottlenecks in understanding health and disease.

heroFeatures.title: Whole-body imaging
heroFeatures.description: DISCO tissue clearing renders entire organisms transparent — then maps them at cellular resolution.

heroFeatures.title: AI-driven analysis
heroFeatures.description: Deep learning segments organs, vasculature, and metastasis across terabyte-scale 3D datasets.

heroFeatures.title: Spatial omics
heroFeatures.description: DISCO-MS and DISCO-seq link 3D anatomy to proteomics and transcriptomics in intact specimens.

technologies.name: MouseMapper
technologies.headline: Whole-body nervous & immune architecture in 3D
technologies.description: Foundation-model deep learning segments and quantifies whole-body nervous and immune systems in cleared mice — revealing systemic remodeling in obesity and disease.
technologies.slogan: Teaching AI to map the whole body.

technologies.name: SCP-Nano
technologies.headline: Nanocarriers traced cell-by-cell through the whole mouse
technologies.description: Single Cell Precision Nanocarrier Identification maps lipid nanoparticles, AAVs, and other carriers across entire mouse bodies at doses 100–1000× below conventional limits.
technologies.slogan: Teaching AI to trace every nanocarrier.

technologies.name: wildDISCO
technologies.headline: Whole-body cellular maps with standard antibodies
technologies.description: Whole-body immunolabeling with standard IgG antibodies and DISCO clearing. Maps nervous, lymphatic, and vascular systems at cellular resolution — no transgenic mice required.
technologies.slogan: Teaching antibodies to map entire organisms.

technologies.name: DISCO-MS
technologies.headline: Spatial proteomics inside cleared organs
technologies.description: Combines 3D imaging with AI-guided robotic extraction and mass spectrometry — spatial proteomics directly in optically cleared pre-clinical and clinical specimens.
technologies.slogan: Teaching cleared tissue to reveal its proteome.

technologies.name: SHANEL
technologies.headline: Transparent human organs at centimeter scale
technologies.description: Permeabilization-based clearing enables antibody-based 3D histology in large human organs — brain, kidney, and beyond — paired with scalable computational analysis.
technologies.slogan: Teaching human organs to become transparent.

technologies.name: VesSAP
technologies.headline: Every capillary in the brain — mapped by AI
technologies.description: End-to-end staining, imaging, and deep-learning segmentation quantifies the entire brain vasculature down to capillaries from terabyte-scale 3D datasets.
technologies.slogan: Teaching AI to see every capillary.

technologies.name: DeepMACT
technologies.headline: AI-detected cancer metastasis across the whole body
technologies.description: Integrates vDISCO tissue clearing, light-sheet microscopy, and deep learning to find micrometastases and quantify therapeutic antibody targeting at single-cell level — 300× faster than manual annotation.

scienceArtMedia.title: wildDISCO — AI at Helmholtz Munich
scienceArtMedia.description: Prof. Ali Ertürk on whole-body cellular mapping with standard antibodies and deep learning.

scienceArtMedia.title: DeepMACT — Cell video abstract
scienceArtMedia.description: Deep learning reveals cancer metastasis and therapeutic antibody targeting across the entire body.

scienceArtMedia.title: SHANEL — transparent human organs

scienceArtMedia.title: wildDISCO 3D atlas
scienceArtMedia.description: Interactive atlas of mouse nervous, vascular, and immune systems — explore cleared whole-body maps.

researchPillars.title: AI-based organ mapping
researchPillars.summary: Using tissue clearing paired with AI deep learning algorithms we map mouse and human organs at the cellular level.
highlights: Skull–meninges connections and drug delivery routes into the brain (Nature Neuroscience, 2019)
Mapping the human brain using SHANEL transparency (Cell, 2020)
Exploiting unbiased vascular analysis (Todorov…Ertürk, 2020, Nature Methods) to investigate brain pathologies including stroke and dementia

researchPillars.title: Precision medicine in cancer
researchPillars.summary: DeepMACT images and analyses cancer metastasis and drug targeting in whole mice at cellular resolution, combined with organoid models and AI profiling.
highlights: Organoid screening pipelines for treatment resistance
Cell-level precision in cancer treatment strategies
